data_output.description: Encoded train and validation splits must preserve canonical row order and provide features with user and item indices, long_view labels, user_ids, and observed watch-time metadata. Validation ground truth is not exposed to the trainer beyond labels needed for training-only early stopping; the fixed evaluator exclusively loads ground truth for final scoring. The fixed command must write predictions_valid.npz with exactly two arrays: row_ids=np.arange(number_of_validation_rows,dtype=int64) and scores, a one-dimensional finite float array aligned to validation input order.

model_input.description: Model receives encoded user/item features plus long_view labels and, for positive long_view impressions only, observed completion-censored watch time transformed as log1p. It must retain the existing additive user/item effects and low-rank interaction, add an auxiliary watch-time prediction head or shared representation, optimize binary long_view loss plus watch_time_loss_weight*mean(max(0, observed_log_watch_time-predicted_log_watch_time)) over eligible positive rows, assign zero auxiliary target and zero auxiliary gradient to non-long-view rows, and expose predict(features) returning only the long_view logits as a one-dimensional array in input order.
